title: An analogue first law for general closed marginally trapped surfaces
summary: We formulate an analogue transverse first law for general closed marginally trapped surfaces in arbitrary spacetimes. The construction is intrinsically quasi-local and is attached directly to an individual marginally trapped surface, rather than to a preferred horizon worldtube. Taking the Hawking energy as the internal energy and an invariant effective surface gravity associated with the marginally trapped surface as the quantity controlling the thermal term, we derive a balance law in which the variation of energy splits into a generalized heat contribution and a total work contribution.…
